title: Automatic alert device for suction cup

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.quote: The present invention is aimed to solve the above addressed issue by providing an automatic alert device for a suction device. The suction device comprises a suction cup and a pump integrated with the suction cup.
features.note: The reference describes a suction device with an integrated pump and an alert device, implying a self-contained unit. However, it does not explicitly mention 'cordless' or 'integrated battery power' for the pump itself, although a battery powers the alert device.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: The reference describes a suction cup and its function but does not explicitly mention a 'flexible sealing lip' or its specific role in bounding a sealed region.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: The suction cup 40 comprises a pumping device (or simply “pump”) integrated therewith and the pump comprises a cylinder 20 in which a plunger 30 is movably received.
features.note: The reference describes a pump integrated with the suction cup, which draws air out to create suction force.

coord.heading: Detailed Description Of The Preferred Embodiments

features.refuted: The quote describes a mechanical pump with a cylinder and plunger, not an electric vacuum pump.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: when the suction force is getting reduced and the plunger is getting out of the pump, a sensor that was originally set in engagement with and thus de-activated by an actuation bar at the time when the suction cup maintains
features.note: The reference describes a sensor that is activated when suction force is reduced, which implies monitoring the vacuum level indirectly through plunger movement. It does not explicitly state a 'pressure sensor' directly monitoring the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: When the outward movement of the plunger reaches a preset extent, the alert device that includes a warning light and an audio alert is activated to cause the warning light and the audio alert to give off warnings of light
features.note: The reference explicitly states that the alert device is activated when the plunger's movement (indicating reduced suction force) reaches a preset extent, which acts as a threshold.
features.refuted: The quote states the alert is activated when the plunger reaches a preset extent, not when the vacuum falls to a threshold above the release vacuum level. While related to vacuum, the trigger mechanism is different.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.quote: When the outward movement of the plunger reaches a preset extent, the alert device that includes a warning light and an audio alert is activated to cause the warning light and the audio alert to give off warnings of light
features.note: The reference describes a 'preset extent' for the plunger movement that triggers the alert, which is related to a reduction in suction force. This implies a threshold, but it doesn't explicitly define it as being relative to a 'load-release vacuum' versus a 'working vacuum'.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.quote: the bent end 361 disengages from the sensor 53 , thereby activating the alert device 50 and the audio alert 56 and the warning light 52 issuing audio and lighting warnings, respectively.
features.note: The reference states the alert device is activated when the sensor disengages, causing warnings to be issued. It doesn't explicitly state that the warning *remains active* as long as the condition persists, but rather that it is activated *by* the condition.

features.quote: the alert device 50 comprises a circuit in which a battery set 54 , an indicator 51 , a warning light 52 , an audio alert 56 , resistors 55 , the sensor 53 , a shut-down switch 57 ,
features.note: The reference mentions a battery set powering the alert device. However, it does not explicitly state that this battery also powers the vacuum pump, nor does it specify if the battery is rechargeable or integrated into a 'rigid body'.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.quote: It is noted that the indicator 51 , the warning light 52 are both arranged at suitable locations on an outer surface of the alert device 50 for easy observation by a user.
features.note: The reference states that the warning light and indicator are on the outer surface of the alert device for easy observation by a user.

coord.heading: Detailed Description Of The Preferred Embodiments

features.refuted: The quote states the indicator and warning light are on an outer surface of the alert device, not specifically on the rigid body. The alert device itself might be on the rigid body, but the quote doesn't explicitly state the indicator is on the rigid body.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: The suction device comprises a suction cup and a pump integrated with the suction cup.
features.note: The reference describes an integrated suction device with a pump and alert system, suggesting a self-contained unit. However, it does not explicitly mention 'single-hand portable design' or the absence of external hoses or cords for the entire device, only that the pump is integrated.

overall.why: The reference describes a self-contained suction device with an integrated pump and an automatic alert system for loss of suction force, which aligns well with the core concept of the subject invention.
